rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Manifestasi naga merah Shichimen Tennyo yang terbang sesudah menerima air; satu naga, tanpa sosok perempuan tambahan.

visual_requirements.description: Satu naga merah bersifat pelindung, satu kepala dan tubuh naga panjang; tidak menambahkan tujuh kepala dari namanya.
Naga terbang ke barat; tetes air biasa menandai cerita diberi air, tanpa hidrokinesis/napas api.

aura: Keagungan naga merah pelindung Dharma c01/c04 dalam momen terbang c07; bukan naga jahat.
artistic_choices: Bentuk naga timur ramping bersisik sebagai rekonstruksi editorial dari istilah naga merah; detail sisik/whisker tidak dinyatakan ikonografi khusus.
Panjang sekitar dua jo c07 dipertahankan melalui atap kuil berukuran biasa; kamera dekat, tidak membesar menjadi seukuran gunung.
Tidak memakai napas api, petir, kendali air, mutiara atau tujuh kepala yang tidak disebut klaim. Cahaya senja/palet editorial.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Shichimen Tennyo in her documented red dragon manifestation, the revered Buddhist guardian of the Lotus Sutra, benevolent and overwhelming [shichimen-tennyo-c01, shichimen-tennyo-c04].
ANATOMY: exactly ONE graceful scarlet eastern dragon, one dragon head and one long winding scaled body, slender whiskers; no wings, no multiple heads, no human figure. A restrained original traditional dragon reconstruction, not a modern entertainment design. Forelimbs tucked close, hind limbs obscured naturally by the coiling body [shichimen-tennyo-c04].
MOMENT: soaring westward directly above the near temple eaves, banking powerfully toward and over the low viewer, head lowered in protective attentive gaze and long red body sweeping through the square [shichimen-tennyo-c07].
POWER: documented dragon flight only; a few ordinary clear water droplets on scales recall the water received before transformation, no spells, fire breath or controlled water [shichimen-tennyo-c07].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close view from under the head, red face and coiling body fill nearly all the square. Dragon is around two jo in length, roughly six metres, against normal-size temple eaves close below, never mountain-sized [shichimen-tennyo-c07].
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low warm sunset from the west, antique-gold rim along wet scarlet scales, deep walnut shadows and cool mountain air.
SURFACE: tactile lacquer-red wet scales and delicate whiskers, aged wooden temple eaves.
SETTING: vicinity of Mount Minobu and Kuon-ji under her protection, an unobtrusive near roof edge and mountain silhouette only [shichimen-tennyo-c04, shichimen-tennyo-c05].
MOOD: sacred, majestic, awe-inspiring guardian presence, resolute and benevolent, never evil, snarling monster, cute or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no extra heads, arms, wings or floating symbols; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no fire, lightning, magic pearl, generic glow aura, neon outlines or energy ribbons; no borrowed design; no nudity or gore.
